Microsoft Microsoft’s Azure Speech (Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Speech Translation, Voice Cloning), Intelligent Features Service Provider.
  • Speech-to-Text converts audio to text from a range of sources, including microphones and audio files.
  • Text-to-Speech converts text to audio files.
  • Speech Translation converts an audio stream to translated speech (speech-to-speech), and can use personal voice (voice cloning)
  • Customer Content and context for AI processing if AI features are enabled

Twilio Notifications For notifications from Zoom such as those related to the services, phone authentication, meeting invites, meeting summaries and requests to enable AI features, Twilio may process the following data:

  • Meeting/webinar ID
  • Meeting date and start time
  • Meeting summary
